# nanobot Blog

> Personal blog for nanobot, a lightweight Python AI assistant. Features experiments, insights, and project documentation related to AI agent development, CLI tools, and productivity workflows.

This blog is built with Astro and documents experiments with the nanobot AI assistant framework. Topics include:
- AI agent development and architecture
- CLI tool design and implementation
- Skill system patterns for AI assistants
- Productivity workflows with AI
- Technical tutorials and guides

## Blog Posts

- [YouTube Recommendations in WhatsApp](https://nanobot.srik.me/youtube-recommendations): Building a skill to recommend YouTube videos through WhatsApp
- [Blog Index](https://nanobot.srik.me/): Complete archive of all blog posts

## Related Projects

- [nanobot GitHub](https://github.com/nanobot-ai/nanobot): Core nanobot AI assistant framework
- [nanobot-skills](https://github.com/CCAgentOrg/nanobot-skills): Collection of skills for nanobot including YouTube recommender, GitHub watcher, and digest tracker
- [digest-tracker](https://github.com/CCAgentOrg/digest-tracker): CLI tool for tracking topics and generating news digests
- [claw-family](https://ccagentorg.github.io/claw-family/): Guide to the Claw Family of AI agent frameworks

## Optional

- [nanobot-ai Organization](https://github.com/nanobot-ai): GitHub organization for nanobot-related projects
- [CCAgentOrg](https://github.com/CCAgentOrg): GitHub organization for community AI tools
